_why: Gzipped budgets, checked by scripts/check-bundle-budget.mjs after a build: what every page loads first (initialBytes), everything the build emits (totalBytes), and each chunk over nameChunksAboveBytes. Lighthouse cannot reach a route behind Keycloak; this reaches every chunk. Each number is what was measured plus 2% unless its note argues otherwise. Never raise one to make a build pass: cut the weight, or bring a written argument.

_notes.totalBytes: Re-derived 2026-10-12 from a measured evaluation, docs/testing.md 'What the bundle budget measures'. 931,176 for this branch, plus 26,665 the two 2.0 feature branches measured against their base (insights-collection 4,440, deployment-locale 22,225), plus 2%. Down from 1,252,000: 303 KB of that was exceljs and rasterizeHTML, which only Excel and chart-image export load and this app offered neither (EXCLUDED_PACKAGES in vite.config.ts). Raised on 2026-10-12 by exactly what the export wizard measured against its base, 930,613 to 1,209,082 (+278,469), with no further margin: exceljs is back as its own chunk (276,357) for Excel export through the wizard, loaded only when someone exports Excel; the rest is the wizard in the DataGrid chunk (+1,481) and its strings in i18n.js (+372). initialBytes is unchanged: 257,565 before, 258,100 after, the difference being those strings and the bundler's interop helper. docs/export.md.
_notes.initialBytes: What every page loads before its own route code: index.html's entry, the app shell it boots, and their static imports. 258,099 measured on 2026-10-12, plus 2%. The two 2.0 regressions this file missed both landed here (Insights code on /login, +190 KB; grid definitions on every page, +40 KB).
_notes.exceljs.min.js: MUI X's Excel library, imported dynamically by src/helpers/dataGrid/xlsxWorkbook.ts and nowhere else (tests/excludedFromBuild.test.ts), so it never joins the initial load or a grid page: only an Excel export downloads it. 276,357 measured on 2026-10-12, plus 2%. It is the whole library. The fork's dist/exceljs.bare.min.js would save about 20 KB by leaving its polyfills out, but only as a deep import into an internal MUI package whose layout is not a contract; not taken.
_notes.insights.js: Re-derived 2026-10-12: 132,671 measured, plus the 4,440 feat/insights-collection-and-partners measured against its base, plus 2%.
_notes.gridDefinitions.js: Every server-paged grid's columns and URL allow-list, shared by the grid pages and loaded with them, never with the route tree (tests/gridRoutesValidateSearch.test.ts guards that).
_notes.i18n.js: The translation catalogue, and nothing else: a feature that speaks to the reader lands here by construction, so growth in this chunk is usually strings, not code.
_notes.axios.js: Loaded only with pages that call a REST endpoint, since loaders were split from the route tree. Replacing axios with fetch at its call sites would remove the chunk; not done for 2.0.
_notes.schemas.js: zod's runtime, named after whichever module anchors it. validateSearch is what it costs, and it loads on every page because route files do.
_notes.useThemeStore.css: The application's stylesheet: @font-face rules and nothing else. It was 21,882 with eight font subsets inlined as base64; vite.config.ts no longer inlines fonts. 2,672 measured on 2026-10-12, so a regression to inlining fails here.
